title: Impossible-Design Explorer — Overview and definition
description: Searches beyond conventional assumptions, then tests designs against physical law. (Proposed capability.)
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Searches beyond conventional assumptions, then tests designs against physical law. (Proposed capability.) An impossible-design explorer would relax standard engineering assumptions, generate unconventional concepts, and immediately test each against conservation laws and known limits. The critical function is the rejection step: most 'impossible' designs fail physics, and the tool must say so. Status: speculative. Capability status: PROPOSED. This database describes a proposed capability, not a completed product. Status taxonomy used throughout: speculative (no demonstrated path), simulated (works in simulation only), experimentally-demonstrated (lab demo exists), independently-verified (reproduced by a third party). Generating a design cannot make impossible physics possible; every record states which status its claims carry. Capability status for this tool: speculative.

title: Impossible-Design Explorer — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Searches beyond conventional assumptions, then tests designs against physical law. (Proposed capability.)
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Impossible-Design Explorer, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Assumption-relaxation concept generation). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Assumption-relaxation concept generation and Conservation-law and limits checking. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Universal Invention Engine) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else. Capability status for this tool: speculative.
